name: Banking Ops Copilot
description: On-call assistant for the payments and core banking night shift. Answers 'what broke and what do I do', pulls the run history, and can trigger pre-approved remediation only — anything touching money or customer data needs a human approval gate.
capabilities: Explain a failed run in plain language
Correlate a break across hub, nostro and ledger
Draft the incident timeline for the shift handover
guardrails: Cannot unblock a card or release a payment
All actions written to the immutable audit log

name: Compliance Research Analyst
description: Answers regulatory and internal-policy questions with citations from the circular library, and pre-fills the evidence pack for audit requests. Read-only by design — it never files, submits or attests to anything.
capabilities: Answer policy questions with circular citations
Summarise a regulatory change and its impacted processes
Assemble evidence for an audit request
Flag where current controls do not cover a new requirement
guardrails: Read-only — cannot submit to the regulator
Every answer must cite a source document
Declines rather than guesses when the library has no coverage
